title: COLLECTION OF PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATES
content:
The Council announces that it has in its custody large quantities of Permanent Certificates for collection.

Registered Professionals who are yet to be issued with their Certificates are advised to check for their names in list below before proceeding to the Council for collection.

Collection by Proxy: The following will strictly be required.

  • a signed authorization note
  • a photocopy of a national photo IDs (for both the applicant and the proxy)

The Period for collection of certificates is between Monday August 02 to Friday September 03, 2021

Failure to collect the printed certificates within the stipulated time will attract a penalty.

For further information and clarification, please contact the Registrar by email at registrar@ahpc.gov.gh / support@ahpc.gov.gh or by phone on 0302 690735

title: Opening of Nominations for GAPHTO National Executive Elections (2021)
content:
The Elections Committee of the Ghana Association of Public Health Officers (GAPHTO) wishes to announce to all members that, it has officially Opened nominations for Qualified Members to Express their desire towards contesting for National Executive Positions of the Association. The Association is due to go to the polls to elect National Executives during the 2021 Annual General Conference to be Hosted in the Volta Region from 25th October 2021.

Article 15 of the GAPHTO Constitution is the legal reference upon which the National Election Committee has drafted the guidelines for the 2021 National Executives Elections.

The Committee equally Consulted the various structures of the Association as well as inputs from committee members to ensure integrity and credibility of the process(s) before, during & after the Elections. This was based on experiences from previous elections within the association and Ghana’s election processes.

Elective Positions

The elective positions of the association for which nominations are being opened are indicated below : 

  1. National President
  2. National Vice President
  3. National General Secretary
  4. National Deputy General Secretary
  5. National Treasurer
  6. National Public Relations Officer

Eligibility Criteria for Nominations

The following fundamental eligibility criteria are required by each contestant for any of the elective positions . They include the following;

  1. The Age of Nominee must be less than 55 years at the time of filing nominations
  2. Nominee should have served for three(3) years or more in his/her practicing profession (Disease Control, Health Information & Nutrition)  from his/her first appointment date.
  3. Nominee should be a member in good standing (dues paying).
  4. Nominee should not have any disciplinary action against him/her within the Association, workplace, in the country or outside the country.
  5. Nominee should not have any criminal record against him/ her within or outside the country.

Required Documents for the Filing of Nominations

The following are required documents to be attached by nominee during submission of nomination forms;

  1. A copy of birth certificate or SSNIT card.
  2. Copy of recent pay slips (most recent 3 months).
  3. Copy of professional academic certificates.
  4. Copy of Any other Relevant Supporting Documents

Process of the Submitting Completed Nominations Forms

All forms and required or additional documents should be;

  1. Scanned (pdf format) and submitted through this email – elections@gaphto.org
  2. Submitted as hard copy to the National Secretariat by any means appropriate by the nominee

Opening & Closing Dates of Nominations

  1. Nomination is opened from Thursday 10th June, 2021

  2. Nomination will be closed on Tuesday 8th September, 2021.

Nomination Form

Interested members May contact their Respective Regional Branch Executives to pick copy of the nomination form or alternatively download a copy below:

title: GAPHTO begins inquiry into alleged stealing of Covid-19 vaccine by healthcare workers
content:
The Ghana Association of Public Health Technical Officers (GAPHTO) has begun an inquiry into an alleged stealing of covid-19 vaccine by healthcare workers.

Members of the Association have condemned the act as it has been the backbone of successful public health interventions across all levels of Ghana’s Health System.

According to a press release, GAPHTO has read a publication by the media about the alleged theft and will apply sanctions associated with such offences.

“GAPHTO has read a publication in sections of the media indicating 3 staff of the Service who work in various levels of the Health Care system in the Greater Accra Region have been arrested for allegedly stealing and selling Covid-19 vaccines.

 

“It will apply appropriate measures/sanctions as prescribed by our Constitution and Code of Ethics will be applied if the said members are found culpable,” a part of the release indicated.

Employees of the Health Ministry, further assures the general public together with all stakeholders that, “we shall ensure all persons eligible for the vaccines get it free of charge. Leadership of the Association will continue to monitor the developing situation and act appropriately.”

title: 2016 Annual General Conference, Bolgatanga
content:
Ghana Association of Public Health Technical Officers (GAPHTO) is a registered association made up of Technical Officers i.e. Disease Control, Health Information, Nutrition, Community Mental Health and Field Technicians working in Ghana Health Service, Ministry of Health and Christian Health Association of Ghana. In line with the constitution of the association, celebration of Annual General Meetings (AGM) where challenges of the group are addressed and where decisions are taken and adapted for the benefit of members has come to stay. It is in line with this that the Upper East regional branch was tasked to host the 2016 edition after the maiden one in 2002. The theme for 2016 conference was: ‘’ Strengthening Community Involvement in Improving Maternal, Newborn and Child Health, the Role of Public Health Technical Officer’’.

title: 2013 Annual General Conference, Tamale
content:
Annual General Conference is one of the major platform in which members of organized bodies meet to discuss issues confronting the group and collectively devise a solution. It also serves as a medium to communicate to those who matters to making the working environment of members conducive and together drive team concerted effort towards accomplishment of agreed objectives.

The Ghana Association of Public Health Technical Officers, is an organized body of Technical officers (nutrition, disease control, Health information) and field technicians working in the various facets of the health services in Ghana. The members of the group can easily be identified working in the CHAG, GHS and Ministry of Health. Like other organized bodies, the association meet annually to discuss issues confronting the association and collectively brainstorm solutions to addressing the challenges.

This report covers the 6th annual conference which was hosted by the Northern regional branch of the association with financial support from the National association. The theme for the conference was Improving Health Data Quality for Effective Planning; the role of the public health technical officers.  This theme was chosen based on how critical data is Quality data is in assessing global or geographical burden of disease. The conference took place at the University of Development Studies (UDS) International Conference Hall from the 28th October, 2013 to 2nd October, 2013.

For Full Conference report, go to the Publications Section of this website.
